comments.P: Clear proof/action split and product list, but type is only “neutral grotesque”, signature is a vague control name, and sticky desktop column under-serves mobile-first. Reads like a thin template skeleton with correct pack nouns.
comments.Q: Strong pack binding: mobile-first spine, hide→make-slot journey, declared have/needed plates, brass-only accent, and honest cream+brass default risk. Signature is solid if less theatrical than R/T. Trade catalog done right.
comments.R: Saddlery bench ticket + gatefold is the most subject-true concept: closed face holds trade facts, open centers Field Tote + hide choice, ticket fills as config. Slight implementability tax for gatefold on mobile; mitigated with sticky CTA.
comments.S: Newsletter/Content-First + Vibrant & Block-based fights sensory leather trade. Rubik/Nunito and emerald/orange system palette conflict with ink/cream/brass. Animated patterns clash with motion-2. Retrieval-shell, not a product direction.
comments.T: Make-slot desk with Hide Grade Strip is the brief’s core care (hide-grade buyers) made visible. Full tokens, mono measurements, plate-first mobile fold, honest missing strap/stitch assets. Highest build confidence without novelty risk.
